notes: Kaleido-Modular-X is a modular, card-based multiviewer built from a Densité frame (1 RU "Densité 3+ FR-1" or 3 RU "Densité 3" chassis) populated with separate input cards (KMX-3901-IN-8-D / -16-D / -16-Q, 8 or 16 SDI inputs each) and output cards (KMX-3901-OUT-D dual-head or -OUT-S single-head), interconnected via proprietary "FlexBridge" coax links; actual I/O counts and connector complement vary by chosen cards/chassis, so no single fixed port list exists. The ports above represent one common "16x2" build: one KMX-3901-IN-16-D input card + one KMX-3901-OUT-D output card in a 1 RU Densité 3+ FR1 frame (rackUnits set to 1 for this config; the 3 RU Densité 3 frame is also offered, and a redundant AC PSU option exists for both). All SDI/LTC/REF/ABT-MADI/FlexBridge connectors are physically miniature DIN 1.0/2.3 coax connectors on the rear panel, not full-size BNC; mapped to "bnc" as the closest available connector id. 3G-SDI support requires an optional license (KMX-IN-x-OPT-3GBPS); base cards are HD/SD-SDI only. HDMI outputs are HDMI v1.3 per the datasheet — grade omitted since v1.3 is below the lowest available grade option (hdmi-1.4). GPI I/O is available only via a separate optional Densité GPI-1501 card and was not included as a port. AC inlet connector type (IEC family) is inferred, not explicitly stated. Category/type do not have an exact "multiviewer" match in the given taxonomy; classified as category "other" / type "Other".
